name: Load NetConf Configuration
description: Copy and load an XML configuration through the ConfD CLI on the active NetConf pod

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace containing netconf-0 and netconf-1

container.description: Container name when the NetConf pod has multiple containers

confd_dir.description: Directory containing run_cli.sh and the XML configuration files

source_config_file.description: Path to the local XML configuration file copied into the master pod

destination_config_file.description: XML filename created and loaded inside the ConfD directory
